# Memmy v1.1.7

## Highlights

- Added the personal Knowledge Base workspace with file browsing, pagination, upload, delete, and search flows.
- Improved Knowledge Base upload and file management behavior, including multipart uploads and larger file limits.
- Updated the Desktop Knowledge page integration and synchronized Memmy application metadata to version 1.1.7.

## Upgrade notes

- Memmy Desktop and Agent are version `1.1.7`.
- The bundled Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned.
- Memory protocol version remains `1`.
